text:
You need a ProEst database set up for residential remodeling estimating that supports unit- and assembly-based estimating, ProEst take-off, and current pricing from your subcontractors and vendors.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I’d be glad to help you build a clean, usable database foundation for that workflow. I have 5 years of experience working with SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, and I’m comfortable organizing data so it’s structured, consistent, and ready for use in estimating systems.

A project that’s especially relevant is my Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture, where I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model that replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports. That work required careful data modeling, consolidation, and making sure the reporting structure was reliable and easy to maintain. The result was that 14 reports were consolidated into 1, and monthly close reporting dropped from 3 days to 4 hours.

I also worked on a Dental clinic expansion model for Sunrise Dental Partners, where I built a three-site expansion model with best, base, and worst cases for patient volume and staffing. That project was built in Excel and focused on scenario analysis and decision support. The result was that 3 sites were compared and the chosen site was projected to pay back in 14 months.

For your ProEst setup, I’d focus on building a residential remodeling-specific database structure that is organized, consistent, and easy to update as pricing changes. I can help review and clean item lists, standardize naming and categories, and structure the data so it supports assembly estimating and take-off needs. I’m detail-oriented with data, and I understand how important it is that the database reflects real-world pricing and matches the way your team estimates work in practice.

If you’d like, I can get started asap and work with you to turn your current pricing and vendor information into a strong estimating database that your team can use with confidence.
